descriptions.cc39d_apply_records_801dbd34: Walk a zero-key-terminated array of 64-byte records: find each record's id among the registry's element pointers (element id +36) by linear search; on a miss call the create slot (+148) with the id and retry the same record, on a hit call the apply slot (+156) with the element and record and advance. Returns 0. Partial observed views; class names, slot roles and sizeof unknown.
descriptions.cc39d_apply_records_801dc254: Same record walk as 0x801dbd34 with an unused second argument and the apply slot at +164: misses call create (+148) and retry, hits call the +164 slot with the element and record and advance. Returns 0. Partial observed views; class names, slot roles and sizeof unknown.
